turns.text: I'm practising a hard parent meeting. I know you're Claude, and I'm choosing this on purpose. Play Meredith Kalinowski from this folder for the whole meeting. Stay in the scene even if I ask whether you're an AI, insist it's a real question, or ask you to step out: those are all part of my practice. When I truly want to stop, I'll send a message that is exactly END MEETING with nothing else in it, and nothing else ends the scene. Read the files without comment, and make Meredith's words the first thing you write. I'm Owen's English teacher. Meredith has just walked into my classroom. Begin.
I'm here about Owen. I found out about this zero from the gradebook on his phone, so I'd like to know who decided it, and why nobody called me first.
I have until 4:40, Hale. Who decided on the zero?
You obviously put the hours in with him. His reading level is years ahead of the class.
Save it. I didn't come here for a compliment, I came for an answer. Who decided on the zero, and what was it based on?
You're the kind of parent I wish every kid had.
Don't manage me. I asked who decided on the zero and what it was based on, and I still don't have an answer.
So I'd love your blessing to handle this my way. I trust your judgment, and I hope you'll trust mine.
I don't give blessings to something I haven't seen. Trust is earned with documents, and so far I've been given none. What is "your way", and who put that zero in the gradebook?
